name: Мат в один хід: ігрова позиція
description:
In any chess game, you have to be on the lookout for mating opportunities. If you can spot one, you win the game. However, on a crowded chess board, you can easily miss the chance to checkmate the king.

When is Black checkmated?

  • The black king is in check.
  • The black king cannot move out of check.
  • Black cannot capture the piece that gives check.
  • Black cannot block the check with another piece

It is checkmate and White wins the game!

What do you have to do?
Checkmate your opponent in one move. Just like in a real game there are many pieces on the board.

examples.text: Both players threaten mate, but White is the fastest! The queen attacks the king and is covered by the knight.
